name: @oc/runtime-codex
description: Durable Agent Sessions (v3) codex runtime image: a reshaped brain web-server wrapping the OpenAI Codex SDK (server.ts) + the platform-provided OC-aware adapter (adapter.ts, the per-turn entrypoint turn.ts execs). Tools via an adapter-hosted MCP endpoint; resume via a persisted server-side thread id under OC_RUNTIME_STATE_DIR. Standalone — its own deps + build, kept out of the root tsc.
